integrity: Complete proof, statement, finite independent program and verification notes are included; bounded program checks are corroboration only. Publisher full text for the closest Cantor-like factor-complexity paper was inaccessible, which remains an originality risk.
limitations: Exact for one-sided infinite fixed points with integral q>=3 and contiguous binary factors only; excludes finite-prefix antidictionaries, scattered subsequences, q=2, and other morphisms. No independent audit.
title: The complete antidictionary of generalized Cantor words
